ABOUT MILAAN

About & Contact

Milaan helps online sellers and small businesses in Pakistan check that a customer's payment really arrived before they ship.

Why Milaan exists

Most small shops on Instagram and WhatsApp are paid by bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa, and customers send a screenshot as proof. Screenshots can be edited, payments can fail after the screenshot is taken, and one screenshot can be sent for two orders. Checking each one against the statement by hand takes hours. Milaan does that matching for you and shows the reason behind every answer.

How it works

Paste your orders, upload your bank or wallet statement PDF, and add the screenshots customers sent. Milaan compares amounts and Transaction IDs and marks every order SHIP, HOLD or REVIEW. You can try the sample shop and read the guide without an account.

Who makes Milaan

Milaan is built by Bilal Ahmed, a computer science student at NUST in Islamabad. It started at the Build With AI hackathon at AICON'26 and is now being developed into a product for small businesses.

Contact

Questions, feedback or want to use Milaan for your business? Send a message through the contact form at bilal-ahmed-builds.cyou. Please don't send passwords, customer details or bank statements in your message.

What Milaan is not

Milaan is not a bank or payment provider. It never logs in to your bank and never moves money. It compares the statement you upload with the screenshots you receive; the shipping decision is always yours.
